item.title: Silver Futures Rise 5 Pc To Rs 2.65 Lakh Per Kg Amid Global Tariff Tensions
item.description: New Delhi, Feb 23: Silver prices on Monday rose nearly 5 per cent to Rs 2,65,282 per kg in the futures market as renewed global tariff tensions boosted demand for safe-haven assets. On the Multi Commodity Exchange (MCX), silver futures for March delivery zoomed Rs 12,338, or 4.88 per cent, to Rs 2,65,282 per kg in 6,024 lots. item.description: HONG KONG, Feb 23: A Hong Kong court Monday dismissed all appeals arising the city’s biggest case brought under a Beijing-imposed national security law. item.title: 18 people killed in bus accident in Nepal’s Dhading
item.description: KATHMANDU, Feb 23: At least 18 people were killed when a passenger bus fell into the Trishuli river near Gajuri in the Dhading district of Nepal early morning on Monday. Twenty-six passengers were injured in the accident that occurred when the bus coming towards Kathmandu from Pokhara plunged into the Trishuli river along the Prithvi Highway, about 90 km west of Kathmandu at 1.30 am, according to Bishnu Prasad Bhatta, spokesperson at the Armed Police Force.
